entries.english: I'm a bit of a connoisseuse when it\ncomes to battling here.<0xFB>If you can win a total of <0xFC>ÀÉ<0xFD>Á<0xFC>ÀÇ\nbattles today in the <0xFC>ÀÉBattle<0xFA>Tower<0xFC>ÀÇ, <0xFC>ÀÉBattle Mine<0xFC>ÀÇ, and <0xFC>ÀÉBattle<0xFA>Circus<0xFC>ÀÇ combined, I'll grant you<0xFA>BP for your hard work.

entries.english: Every day I hope to see more lovely\nwin counts, just like the one you<0xFA>showed me today.

entries.english: I've noticed this shady guy has\nbeen lurking outside the <0xFC>ÀÉBattle<0xFA>Tower<0xFC>ÀË very late at night.<0xFB>Word is he offers great deals, but\nthen swindles you.<0xFB>I'd be on your guard around him.
entries.french_reference: J'ai remarqué un type louche qui\ntraîne tard devant la {COLOR}ÉBattle\lTower{COLOR}Ë.\pIl paraît qu'il propose de super\naffaires, puis t'arnaque.\pJe me méfierais à ta place.
entries.portuguese: Vi um sujeito suspeito rondando\na <0xFC>ÀÉBattle<0xFA>Tower<0xFC>ÀË bem tarde da noite.<0xFB>Dizem que oferece bons negócios,\nmas depois passa a perna em você.<0xFB>Eu tomaria cuidado com ele.

entries.english:
I just love the <0xFC>ÀÉBattle Sands<0xFC>ÀÇ!<0xFB>Watching as others battle with your
prized Pokémon is so entertaining!<0xFB>Not to mention the fact that it's a
super easy way to earn BP.<0xFB>There's no other battle facility
I'd call my favourite.
entries.french_reference:
J'adore le {COLOR}ÉBattle Sands{COLOR}Ç !\pRegarder d'autres combattre avec tes
Pokémon préférés, c'est si amusant !\pSans parler du fait que c'est très
facile pour gagner des PB.\pAucune autre installation de combat
ne serait mon endroit favori.
entries.portuguese:
Adoro a <0xFC>ÀÉBattle Sands<0xFC>ÀÇ!<0xFB>Ver os outros lutarem com seus
Pokémon favoritos é divertido!<0xFB>E ainda é um jeito muito fácil
de ganhar BP.<0xFB>De todas as instalações daqui,
essa é a minha favorita.
entries.reason: Traduction PT-BR comparée aux sources EN/FR.

entries.english: The <0xFC>ÀÉBattle Circus<0xFC>ÀË!<0xFB>Loads of fun!<0xFB>What will happen next?<0xFB>Wait and see!
entries.french_reference: Le {COLOR}ÉBattle Circus{COLOR}Ë !\pTellement fun !\pQue va-t-il se passer ensuite ?\pAttends et vois !
entries.portuguese: O <0xFC>ÀÉBattle Circus<0xFC>ÀË!<0xFB>Quanta diversão!<0xFB>O que vai acontecer agora?<0xFB>Espere para ver!
entries.reason: Traduction PT-BR comparée aux sources EN/FR.

entries.english:
Some of the vendors change
periodically during the day.<0xFB>You'll want to stay outside as much
as possible if you're interested in<0xFA>shopping.<0xFB>I find the <0xFC>ÀÉBattle Sands<0xFC>ÀÇ is a good
way to pass the time while I wait.
entries.french_reference:
Certains vendeurs changent
périodiquement dans la journée.\pSi tu veux faire du shopping, reste
autant dehors que possible\lpour acheter.\pJe trouve que le {COLOR}ÉBattle Sands{COLOR}Ç est
un bon moyen de patienter.
entries.portuguese:
Alguns vendedores mudam
ao longo do dia.<0xFB>Se quiser fazer compras,
vale ficar lá fora o máximo<0xFA>de tempo possível.<0xFB>A <0xFC>ÀÉBattle Sands<0xFC>ÀÇ é ótima para
passar o tempo enquanto espero.
entries.reason: Traduction PT-BR comparée aux sources EN/FR.

entries.english:
There ain't no mine like the <0xFC>ÀÉBattle
Mine<0xFC>ÀË, I tells ya.<0xFB>Most other mines" well" you know
what you're getting yourself into.<0xFB>Not in the Battle Mine, I tells ya.<0xFB>Every floor you go down shakes
things up.<0xFB>It's a harrowing experience!
entries.french_reference:
Y a pas de mine comme la {COLOR}ÉBattle
Mine{COLOR}Ë, j'te l'dis.\pDans la plupart des mines… tu sais
à quoi t'attendre.\pPas dans la Battle Mine, j'te l'dis.\pChaque étage bouleverse
 tout.\pC'est une sacrée expérience !
entries.portuguese:
Não há mina como a <0xFC>ÀÉBattle
Mine<0xFC>ÀË, pode crer.<0xFB>Nas outras minas... bem...
você sabe o que esperar.<0xFB>Na Battle Mine, não, pode crer.<0xFB>Cada andar que você desce
muda tudo.<0xFB>É uma experiência de arrepiar!
